issues.title: wrong venue
issues.author: francoismichel
issues.body:
It seems that something went wrong in commit d224c79 which is an automated commit made by running `make -f lib/setup.mk` when using martinthomson/i-d-template.
I don't know what happened, but something in that script identified the WG as the Spatial Reuse Protocol (SRP) instead of DNSSD.
So we can either ask for a presentation at the Spatial Reuse Protocol WG or update the venue of this draft. I propose the latter... :-)

comments.author: Abhayakara
comments.body: Huh, interestingly, it's often the case that space is leased, just like SRP registrations. Maybe there's an opportunity for additional use cases here...

pulls.title: Rename the option to "SRP Optimisations Option" and the ability to omit keys
pulls.author: francoismichel
pulls.body:
The option now becomes a bitmap that signals what optimizations we want to enable in our request.
Only 2 bits are defined right now: R signals that we want to remove all services for this hostname, and K signals that we omit the key in the update.

I am not too sure about the name, it almost makes me want to call it SRP Options but at the same time, it could get confused with DNS OPT records, and it really broadens the scope of the document.
